evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a katana (curved slender blade, round tsuba disc, ribbed tsuka, kashira cap); outline symmetric, A15 Y error 0.0, alignment offsets 0.0, all seats seated with no gap; top view is just the tsuba ring, as with any sword.
evidence.V2: Big blade, medium tsuba disc and tsuka, small habaki, wrap ribs, ink tsuba face and kashira cap give a clear three-level read, though the small tier is thin: the single-colour wrap ribs are low contrast.
evidence.V3: Blade is a near-uniform-width rod with gentle sori and a rounded, blunt kissaki (reads closer to a bokken than a katana tip); habaki is a plain box and tsuba a plain disc, so the parts stay close to primitives rather than a confident stylised exaggeration like the anchor's flared blade and swept guard.
evidence.V4: Chamfers are consistent and catch light on the tsuba rim, habaki corners, kashira rim and the blade's shinogi facets; no razor edges or blobs.
evidence.V5: Mostly clean smooth shading, but minor issues show in the close-ups: visible polygon faceting on the kashira's rounded bottom rim, a small crease/pinch where the ridge lines converge at the kissaki tip, and a small notch at the blade/habaki junction in the tsuba flat close-up.
evidence.V6: Disciplined: steel greys in two values on the blade, gold fittings, ink-dark tsuba face, one hue for the wrap; crimson and shadow colourways swap only the wrap hue and keep strong value contrast.
evidence.V7: 2396 tris against weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000), at or under target.
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material, kit gold/ink/steel palette with one wrap hue, matching chamfer scale and smooth shading; sits alongside the Scimitar anchor without clashing.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle, origin at grip, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic.
